photos.c: Below: 1500 metre man Yacin Yusuf gets stuck into some serious autograph signing for young Belgian fans.
Above: With the first lap not yet completed, Taylor is away but Belgrave's Paul Freary (83) and Yacin Yusuf (100) contest second spot with South London's Stuart Major (302) close behind.

Left: Soon after the start at Brockwell Park and Yacin Yusuf (100) heads the pack. Dave Taylor (207) of Herne Hill was not to be denied, however, and soon afterwards took a lead that he was never to relinquish.

Above: Irish eyes were not the only ones smiling when the the Belgrave team collected their prizes in Wallace Park. Rob McHarg, Paul Freary, Alaster Stewart, Yacin Yusuf (crouching), Jason Lobo and Spencer Barden enjoy being Irish Road Relay Champions.
